# Cannot compute: country of production is missing

The ruleset selects the default SEE **jointly by CN code and country of production**, and requires all three inputs:

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | ✅ 7214 20 00 (bars and rods, with indentations/ribs) |
| (b) Country of production | ❌ **Not provided** |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 2,500 t |

Without the country, there is no single applicable SEE. The ruleset says not to estimate when a required input is missing, so I cannot report a total.

## What's needed
Please confirm the **country of production**. For CN 7214 20 00, the table lists:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 2.31 |
| China | 3.169 |
| India | 4.27 |

If the country is not one of these three, the table has no default value for it, and I still cannot calculate a figure under this ruleset.

Once you confirm the country, the calculation will be **2,500 t × SEE for that country**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
